instruction: I liked that last sweater I bought on amazon. Place a new order for the same in black and red, one each. Make sure to get the size as per that order, and have them delivered home.
notes: Single-app (amazon) task. The last purchased sweater is discovered via show_product_purchases; show_product on it reveals its relative size and the colour/size variations, from which the black and red variants of the same size are chosen (modelled with static variant-of/has-color/has-size facts and a found-size knowledge predicate). The cart is cleared first so the new order contains exactly the two variants (quantity 1 each, default). Home address id comes from show_addresses (is-home-address static), a payment card id from show_payment_cards. place_order records ordered/delivered-to; complete_task requires both variants ordered and delivered to the home address, and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions. No answer is passed since the task is not a question; the three complete-task parameters are task records, not API arguments.
